gallery.description: Baldwin the fourth, as his crusader armies meet with Saladin’s forces at Montgisard, considered Baldwin’s greatest victory, He achieved a decisive victory over Sultan Saladin’s army. Baldwin at the time of the battle was 16 and suffering from both Malaria and severe Leprosy.
